    'Core_bottom': '134c4f67-a2ef-5cd4-b03a-f18a5601c587',

    for row in r:

        if not row['timestamp'].startswith('2018-10-12'): continue
        v = float(row['value'])
        name = [k for k,tt in ids.items() if tt==tid][0]
        totals[name] += v
        counts[name] += 1

print(counts)
best = max(totals.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])
print('BEST:', best)
